method: Each fact below was written by JanSetu from a dated, read-only snapshot of the named official page (data/website_enrichment/research/2026-10-17). Every evidence item keeps the exact page text it relies on; tools/website_enrichment.py validate refuses a quote that is not in the saved snapshot. The app receives the short JanSetu wording, source links and dates only, never the quotes.
reviewPolicy: source_checked = an automated agent compared each fact with the quoted official text; it is not a human review. Human review is never written in this file: it is derived from named, dated decisions in reviews.json (tools/editorial_review.py). Drafts (proposed), held profiles and held fields are never packaged into the app.
reuseNote: Quotes are retained here only as review evidence. Permission to reproduce official website text, and NIC permission for IGOD-derived data, are unresolved release blockers (docs/PHASE6B_ENRICHMENT_REPORT.md).
